triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: Alyosha remained for some time irresolute after hearing the command his father shouted to him from the carriage.

triples.subject: Alyosha
triples.quote: He had a great longing to run and see his brother Dmitri before that fateful interview.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: Dmitri led his brother to the most secluded corner of the garden.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: I could take you in my arms, Alyosha, and press you to my bosom till I crush you, for in the whole world—in reality—in re-al-i-ty—(can you take it in?) I love no one but you!

triples.subject: Alyosha
triples.quote: “Here is her note.” Alyosha took it out of his pocket.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: Listen, Alyosha, listen, brother! Now I mean to tell you everything, for I must tell some one.

triples.subject: Alyosha
triples.quote: Listen, Alyosha, listen, brother! Now I mean to tell you everything, for I must tell some one.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: For I’m a Karamazov. For when I do leap into the pit, I go headlong with my heels up

triples.subject: Alyosha
triples.quote: All we Karamazovs are such insects, and, angel as you are, that insect lives in you, too
